subject: Problem with writing plot output on custom HTML interface

messages.author: 0e10ba730d2f32ae
messages.subject: Problem with writing plot output on custom HTML interface
parts:
Hi All,

I have created a custom HTML interface and currently trying to display a scatter plot output on the HTML page. I am unable to print the output and I believe the problem is because I am placing the output code in the wrong location. Please help me fix this issue. Given below is my code.


index.HTML

function onbuttonclick()
 {
 var select1 = document.getElementById("test2"); #combo box 2
 var select2 = document.getElementById("test3"); # combo box 3
 var displayarea = document.getElementById("myArea");
 var value2="";
 var value3="";
    value2 = document.getElementById("test2").options[select2.selectedIndex].text; # gets the column name chosen by user from combo box two
    value3 = document.getElementById("test3").options[select3.selectedIndex].text; # gets the column name chosen by user from combo box three
<div id="scatter" class="shiny-plot-output" style="width: 100%; height: 400px"> </div>;
}

<form method="POST" action="t.cgi" onsubmit="dofirst()">

<textarea id="myArea" rows="25" cols="125" style="color: black">
<div id="scatter"></div>  # THIS IS THE DISPLAY AREA TO BE USED FOR RESULT DISPLAY
</textarea>




Server.R

dt<-read.csv("test.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 
output$scatter <- renderPlot(function(session){
temp1 <- dt[[input$value2]]
temp2 <- dt[[input$value3]]
plot(temp1, temp2, xlab = input$value2, ylab = input$value3)
    })
